description: This file contains unit tests for session filtering functionality related to chat sessions in the ai.openclaw.app UI module. It verifies the correct ordering of session choices based on recency and handles cases where the current session is missing.

classes.name: SessionFiltersTest
classes.description: Test suite for verifying session filtering and choice prioritization logic in chat UI.

methods.name: sessionChoicesPreferMainAndRecent
methods.description: Tests that the session choices prioritize 'main' and the most recent sessions.

methods.name: sessionChoicesIncludeCurrentWhenMissing
methods.description: Tests that the current session is included in the choices even if it is missing from the list.
